title: cross-language streaming checkpoint and compact-retry spec; bump py/ts/go sdks
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: Customers building long-running streaming pipelines asked for a small, consistent way to persist and resume progress across SDKs without re-sending large prompts or reconstructing KV caches. This PR introduces a compact, cross-language streaming checkpoint spec and implements ergonomic client helpers in Python/TypeScript/Go, plus a minor retry-profile consolidation to reduce head-of-line stalls during resume. Changes are designed to be backwards-compatible: existing streaming APIs continue to work, new helpers are additive. Key deliverables: 1) spec/api-docs: a new streaming-checkpoint section in api-specs/streaming.md that defines a checkpoint blob format (versioned, protobuf-compatible but expressed as base64 JSON for portability) and resume semantics; 2) SDK ergonomics: added Stream.checkpoint() and Client.resume_stream_from_checkpoint(checkpoint) helpers in Python/TS/Go with clear examples; 3) Retry profile: introduce "adaptive-compact-v2" retry profile used by resume codepaths (shorter jitter window + idempotency-safe backoff) and documented tradeoffs; 4) Tests and interop: end-to-end interop test harness that validates cross-language checkpoints (python -> ts -> go resume permutations) and CI safety gates; 5) Version bumps: py 0.14.0, ts 1.9.0, go 1.5.0 and package metadata changes. Migration notes: for most users nothing to change; to opt-in to resumable streams call stream.checkpoint() periodically and pass the blob to resume_stream_from_checkpoint(). If you rely on custom retry tuning around streaming, review the new "adaptive-compact-v2" profile; it is conservative and safe for most workloads but can be overridden via existing retry config. Testing: added unit + integration tests; manual interop runs on Linux amd64 and Darwin in CI matrix. Rollout: merged to main; SDK packages staged for release once CI artifacts are available. Checklist: [x] spec drafted and reviewed by API team; [x] python impl and tests; [x] typescript impl and tests; [x] go impl and tests; [x] docs and changelogs updated; [x] release bumps updated; [x] performance regression verified minimal. Links: Linear ENG-1197, ENG-1203; support ticket SUP-402.

release_notes: Add streaming checkpoint helpers to Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs allowing resumable streams across languages; introduce adaptive-compact-v2 retry profile for resume flows; bump SDK versions: python 0.14.0, typescript 1.9.0, go 1.5.0. Backwards compatible. See docs/streaming-checkpoints.md for usage examples.
notes_on_compatibility: Additive API: Stream.checkpoint and resume helpers are new opt-in helpers. Existing streaming behavior unchanged. Checkpoint format is versioned; older SDKs will ignore unknown fields. Operators can opt out of adaptive-compact-v2 by overriding retry config.
qa_summary: Unit tests for each SDK, integration cross-language tests that exercise resume permutations, and a small e2e harness that validates no KV cache leakage. Performance microbenchmarks show <3% median latency increase during checkpointing at 1s checkpoint intervals and reduced token re-generation on resume.
